+++ b/models/staging/_sources.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+version: 2
+
+sources:
+  - name: raw
+    schema: raw
+    description: >
+      Public signals landed by `gta6 ingest` as Parquet under data/raw/ and loaded by
+      `gta6 load`. Every table is rebuilt from the files on each load; the newest pull
+      wins per key. No post text, handles or usernames are stored.
+    tables:
+      - name: wiki_pageviews
+        description: Daily English Wikipedia pageviews by users (all access) per article.
+      - name: trends_interest
+        description: >
+          Google Trends relative interest (0-100) per term and day. Values only compare
+          within one request_id; Google rescales every request to its own peak.
+      - name: bluesky_daily_hits
+        description: >
+          Bluesky public search hitsTotal for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta")
+          bounded to one UTC day. hits_total is NULL when the call failed.
+      - name: hn_daily_hits
+        description: >
+          Hacker News (Algolia) nbHits for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta")
+          over stories and comments in one UTC day. NULL when the call failed.
+      - name: reddit_items
+        description: >
+          Reddit posts and comments (Arctic Shift archive) that matched a day-off seed in a
+          tracked subreddit, with flags computed from the text at ingest. Text is discarded.
+      - name: reddit_coverage
+        description: >
+          One row per (subreddit, kind, seed, weekly slice) we asked Arctic Shift for, with
+          whether paging completed, was capped, or failed.

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+with source as (
+    select * from {{ source('raw', 'wiki_pageviews') }}
+)
+
+select
+    article,
+    cast(timezone('UTC', ts) as date) as view_date,
+    cast(views as bigint) as views
+from source
+where granularity = 'daily'

+++ b/models/staging/stg_trends__interest.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+-- Each Trends request is scaled to its own 0-100, so we keep exactly one request per
+-- (term group, geo, study year): the newest. Mixing requests would mix scales.
+with source as (
+    select
+        *,
+        cast(split_part(request_id, '-', 3) as integer) as study_year
+    from {{ source('raw', 'trends_interest') }}
+),
+
+newest as (
+    select term_group, geo, study_year, max(request_id) as request_id
+    from source
+    group by term_group, geo, study_year
+)
+
+select
+    source.request_id,
+    source.study_year,
+    source.term_group,
+    source.geo,
+    source.term,
+    source.day as interest_date,
+    cast(source.interest as integer) as interest,
+    source.is_partial
+from source
+inner join newest
+    on source.request_id = newest.request_id

@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+version: 2
+
+models:
+  - name: stg_wiki__pageviews
+    description: 'One row per Wikipedia article per UTC day: daily user pageviews.'
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          grain:
+            - article
+            - view_date
+          population:
+            rule: Daily-granularity rows only; the per-article API serves no hourly data.
+            filters:
+              - column: granularity
+                includes:
+                  - daily
+          assumptions:
+            - decision: Which day a timestamp belongs to
+              chosen: the UTC date of ts
+              evidence: data
+              detail: explore showed ts rendered at +01:00/+02:00 in a local session; the API's timestamps are UTC midnights
+    columns:
+      - name: article
+        description: English Wikipedia article title.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: view_date
+        description: UTC day. The raw ts is a UTC midnight stored as TIMESTAMPTZ; converted explicitly so the session time zone cannot shift it.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: time
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: views
+        description: Pageviews by users (agent=user), all access methods.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: measure
+              null_rule: never
+              aggregation: sum
+              additivity: additive
+              unit: count
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null

@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+version: 2
+
+models:
+  - name: stg_trends__interest
+    description: One row per Trends term per day, from the newest request for each (term group, geo, study year).
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          grain:
+            - term_group
+            - geo
+            - study_year
+            - term
+            - interest_date
+          population:
+            rule: Only the newest request per (term_group, geo, study_year); older pulls are dropped because each request has its own 0-100 scale.
+          assumptions:
+            - decision: How to combine repeated Trends pulls
+              chosen: keep only the newest request per (term_group, geo, study_year)
+              evidence: default
+              detail: Trends rescales each request; averaging requests would mix scales
+            - decision: Study year source
+              chosen: third dash-separated part of request_id
+              evidence: contract
+              detail: request_id is written as <group>-<geo>-<year>-<stamp> by gta6_impact.ingest.trends
+    columns:
+      - name: request_id
+        description: The Trends request the value came from; values only compare within one request.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: attribute
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: study_year
+        description: 2026 = study window, 2025 = seasonality control.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: term_group
+        description: '''day_off'' (call in sick, sick day, PTO, day off work) or ''hype'' (GTA 6). Requested separately.'
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: geo
+        description: '''US'' or ''WORLD''.'
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: term
+        description: The search term.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: interest_date
+        description: The day Google reports, in Google's own day boundaries.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: time
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: interest
+        description: Relative search interest; 100 is the peak of that request.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: measure
+              null_rule: never
+              aggregation: max
+              additivity: non_additive
+              unit: index (0-100, relative within request)
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: is_partial
+        description: Google marks the latest day partial while it is still filling in.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: attribute
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null

+version: 2
+
+models:
+  - name: stg_bluesky__daily_hits
+    description: 'One row per Bluesky search (seed phrase x gta filter) per UTC day: the hitsTotal Bluesky reported.'
+    config:
+      meta:
+        dex:
+          grain:
+            - hit_date
+            - seed
+            - gta_filter
+          population:
+            rule: Every query we asked, including failed ones (hits_total NULL).
+          assumptions:
+            - decision: Grain
+              chosen: '(hit_date, seed, gta_filter): one search per key per day'
+              evidence: data
+              detail: 'probe .dex/review/06-*.json: distinct (day, seed, gta_filter) equals row count. observed_at is unique only because every request is timed separately; it is not the grain'
+            - decision: Population
+              chosen: every query this source was asked, independent of the other search source
+              evidence: request
+              detail: Bluesky and Hacker News are searched with the same seeds on the same days, but neither is a parent of the other
+            - decision: A failed call
+              chosen: kept with hits_total NULL and is_available false
+              evidence: request
+              detail: missing is unavailable, never zero (docs/methodology.md)
+    columns:
+      - name: hit_date
+        description: UTC day the count covers.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: time
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: seed
+        description: Day-off seed phrase searched, quoted.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: gta_filter
+        description: '''any'' = the phrase alone; ''gta'' = the phrase plus the word gta.'
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: dimension
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: query
+        description: The exact query string sent.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: attribute
+      - name: hits_total
+        description: Matches Bluesky reports for the query in that UTC day.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: measure
+              null_rule: 'NULL when the Bluesky call failed: unavailable, never zero.'
+              aggregation: sum
+              additivity: additive
+              unit: count
+      - name: is_available
+        description: True when hits_total was returned.
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: attribute
+              null_rule: never
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: observed_at
+        description: When the count was read (counts can move as indexes update).
+        config:
+          meta:
+            dex:
+              role: attribute
